#### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Recall paid-month credit (Oct monthly bill)**

The hub, "…Recall Paid-Month Credit: Policy and Posting Action", applies. Its conditions hold:

- the purchaser came under AD coverage during the MRPM (applied, effective Oct 8);
- a later month (Nov) is already billed.

Computation:

- **Baseline.** Days after the plan termination date; there is none, so the fall-back is **0.00**.
- **Start day.** The effective date is inside the MRPM, so counting starts Oct 8.
- **First counted day.** Counting starts from the effective date, but the enrollment was applied *after* that day (Oct 10), so "the first day counted is the day after the application date": **Oct 11**.
- **Active-duty length.** More than 30 days, so the days count.
- **Credited days.** Oct 11–31, 21 days.
- **Settled change.** The change credit 802.33 against the Oct bill is taken off.
- **Change days.** The change covers 29 days (part of the month), from Oct 3, so it reaches all 21 credited days.
- **Spread.** Over 29 days.

Value: 21×1471.73/31 − 21×802.33/29 = 996.978387 − 580.997586 = 415.980801, which rounds to **415.98**.

Parameters: related `34f74f16-44ee-4e1c-81e4-e305d094e462`, month 2026-10, days 21.

**(b) Recall adjustment relief (Oct adjustment bill)**

The hub applies: an adjustment was billed for the MRPM, and AD coverage after the recall carries days of Oct 7–31.

- **Baseline.** Nothing, so the fall-back is **0.00**.
- **Start day.** The effective date Oct 8 is inside the period Oct 7–31, so counting starts Oct 8.
- **First counted day.** The enrollment was applied Oct 10, after Oct 8, so the first day counted is **Oct 11**.
- **Length.** More than 30 days.
- **Relieved days.** Oct 11–31, 21 days.
- **Daily amount.** Unpaid, so 691.66/25 = 27.6664.
- **Posting limit.** The plan is active, so the relief is posted up to the 691.66 still owed.

Value: 21×27.6664 = 580.9944, which rounds to **580.99**.

Parameters: related `d2e48eab-9ca8-4eb3-a890-aa692031bd1d`, month 2026-10, days 21.

- **Coverage reach.** More than 30 days, so through the last day of the month, Nov 30.
- **Days.** 30.
- **Daily amount.** No payment against the bill, so 614.07/30.

Value: **614.07**.

Parameters: related `9b07371d-8a99-440e-8fcd-b9104068dd9b`, month 2026-11, days 30.

#### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone

The root is the TRR confirmation. Its hub carries three prerequisite sentences:

- **(P1)** "The Retired Reserve closing reconciliation is figured only after the monthly bill of the most recently paid month carries the recall paid-month credit owed for its days of active duty coverage."
- **(P2)** "…is not figured before the coverage-type adjustment billed for the most recently paid month carries the recall adjustment relief owed…"
- **(P3)** "…is figured only after the monthly bill of a later latest-billed month carries the recall month relief owed…"

Each hop:

- **Hop 1 (P1), state-derived.** No activation_on_orders credit stands against the Oct monthly bill. The "Recall Paid-Month Credit: Policy and Posting Action" document describes the write, a credit "against the monthly bill of the most recently paid coverage month". The Prime record (applied, effective Oct 8) shows the purchaser came under AD coverage in October, and November is already billed.
- **Hop 2 (P2), state-derived.** No credit stands against Oct adjustment `d2e48eab`. The "…Coverage-Type Adjustments and the Recall Adjustment Relief" document describes the write against the MRPM's adjustment bill.
- **Hop 3 (P3), state-derived.** No credit stands against Nov monthly `9b07371d`. The "Recall Month Relief on TRICARE Retired Reserve Advance Bills" document describes the write against "the monthly bill of that latest-billed month".

No depended-on document carries a prerequisite sentence of its own, so the tree has depth 1 with three leaves. Order: {P1, P2, P3} in any order, then the root. No hop was pre-solved.

#### Counter-proofs

- **"Just confirm."** This is excluded by P1–P3 together with the records: none of the three credits stands.
- **First-day alternatives.** Reading Oct 8 as the first day counted (ignoring the application date) would give 24 days, with RPMC 475.41 and RAR 663.99. That reading is excluded by the first-counted-day documents: "where it is counted from either of those days and the enrollment was applied for after that day, the first day counted is the day after the application date". The Prime record shows application_date 2026-10-10, which is after the effective date of 2026-10-08.
- **Termination date.** Alternatives 10-17 and 10-20 are excluded by the "later of" rule. The caller's own date, 11-09, is the later date.
- **Bill that carries the root credit.** The Nov adjustment bill is excluded by "posted against the monthly bill of the latest-billed coverage month". The root credit goes on Nov monthly `9b07371d`, the same bill that carries the recall month relief.
- **No later-month relief for the TRR Nov adjustment.** The visible corpus has no TRR counterpart of the later-month family relief. The unpaid Nov adjustment therefore comes into the closing reconciliation in full. This matches the hub definition "premium billed for days of the closing period that the plan no longer charges for and that no credit has yet returned or relieved".
- **Fall-back numbers.** RPMC 0.00, RAR 0.00, RMR 0.00, RRCR 1030.21. Each is definite and each differs from the derived value.
- **Factor findability.** The factor documents are reached from the words the records use: TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member (status, effective date, application_date, disenrollment_date), coverage_type_change credit, coverage_type_adjustment bill, activation_on_orders credits, and plan status active. This is the same mapping as task 0, carried by the TRR-specific documents. One TRR factor ("How Far Recall Coverage Runs…", coverage reach) is read from disenrollment_date.
